name: Drought
value: E Africa, S Africa, Australia wheat hit
summary: El Niño drought threatens East and southern Africa and Australia's wheat
state: FEWS NET flags high concern for El Niño-driven drought in Ethiopia, South Sudan, Sudan and southern Africa this season. The EU's Joint Research Centre (7 Oct) says weather extremes are worsening food security in East Africa and threaten the next harvest in southern Africa; Australia's wheat crop is forecast 14–17% lower. No harvest failure is confirmed as of 3 Nov.
for_you: Food import costs could rise; follow FEWS NET and FAO for regional food security.
rubric_hit: Severe drought in major crop regions = Watch

sources.title: JRC — El Niño extremes worsen food security

why: Drought slowly destroys harvests, hydropower and river shipping, and drives famine and migration.
drivers: Rainfall deficits, heat, ENSO, groundwater depletion.

rubric.alert: Drought driving famine conditions, a major exporter's harvest failure, or monsoon failure across a major breadbasket.
rubric.watch: Severe drought in a major crop region, a major river at record low, or a monsoon running more than 20% below normal.
rubric.normal: No major breadbasket in severe drought.
